pages.quiz:
MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Brown, pink, and gold

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Singing Games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Singing Games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Singing Games.
   D. Damage equipment used for Singing Games.

4. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   D. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Elements of Music RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Elements of Music RESPONDING.
   D. Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.

7. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

8. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

9. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   C. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

10. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Red, blue, and yellow

2. B — The speed of the music

3. A — Practise Singing Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Practise Elements of Music RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. A — Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

8. B — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. C — Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Musical Instruments; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Rhythm COMPOSING; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Melody; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
